zh-CN.title: 空间登录入口更清晰
items: PWA 选择空间后会直接进入普通用户登录，不再混入管理员入口
登录页新增微信登录指引，并清理已停用的头像与发言卡片外观

en.title: Clearer space sign-in
items: Choosing a space in the PWA now opens regular member sign-in without admin entry points
The sign-in page adds WeChat guidance and retires obsolete avatar and statement-card appearances
